newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Union says test shows more gold in PNG.
newsitem.headline: Union says test shows more gold in PNG.

text.p: Union Mining NL said on Thursday that recent drilling confirmed a potential zone of gold mineralisation on its Igwageta prospect in Papua New Guinea.

"At Igwageta, significant to strong mineralisation was encountered in 29 of the 46 reverse circulation drill holes, totalling 2,135.5 metres, which provide the initial tests of the prospect's defined targets, all six of which intersected zones of significant gold mineralisation," Union said.

The 15 holes that tested the most interesting target have defined a bulk mineralised body with intersections including 14 metres of 5.64 grammes of gold per tonne of ore, 26 metres of 1.06 g/t, 14 metres of 1.03 g/t and 8 metres of 1.02 g/t. All intercepts are within 40 metres of the surface, Union said.
Drilling also was continuing at the other two major prospects at Wapolu and Gameta, the company said.
Previous drilling at Wapolu and Gameta has identified an independently confirmed resource totalling about 510,000 ounces of gold.
